title: Change email confirmation?
summary: I recently changed the email associated with my NewsBlur account (via the Account panel). I anticipated receiving a confirmation email at the old address, but never saw one. Similarly, I never saw an email at the new address stating that the address had been changed. Is this expected? A change confirmation email, at the very least, would be helpful to know that the change “took” so to speak.

I recently changed the email associated with my NewsBlur account (via the **Account** panel). I anticipated receiving a confirmation email at the old address, but never saw one. Similarly, I never saw an email at the new address stating that the address had been changed. Is this expected? A change confirmation email, at the very least, would be helpful to know that the change “took” so to speak.
